name: Misugi Ryoutarou
source:
"The path I walk... is filled with nothing but beauty" 

 A beautiful man. His fascinating voice attracts the women of the world, be they young or old. "Sugi-sama! Kyakya!" 

 Battle quote - "Fufu... beauty... is deceiving!"
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
